description: Suggest a change to a Markdown Document or Markdown Spreadsheet for the owner to review. A document is a title and its content. Pass markdown to replace the body. Pass title to rename it. Topics are assigned automatically. Omit markdown for a title-only suggestion. Metadata-only suggestions work on markdown and table documents only. Legacy linked documents are read-only and don't accept suggestions; use comment on them. New Markdown must be 24,000 bytes or smaller. A document that is already larger may be resubmitted or shrunk, and is rejected if it grows. Sign action "propose" with {documentId, baseRevisionId, content?:{kind:"markdown", markdown}, details?:{title?}, message?}.
name: suggest_edit
title: Suggest an edit
